text: #6142 (date/time functions reject Character/Numeric/Logical/Object args with error 11; DTOT date-only, TTOD datetime-only; GOMONTH/DOW need numeric 2nd arg) done on a branch stacked on the typed-literals PR #6733; opens after #6733 merges.
